note: Both sets extract a good amount of information from the wiring schedule and notes, but both suffer from OCR errors (interpreting '3#4/0' as '3440'). Set A misreads the conductor configuration for Cable 20. Set B invents a non-existent Cable 24 and misreads the wire gauge for Cable 50. Because both sets contain a similar number of significant errors and hallucinations, they are of comparable quality.
